notes.title: Tiny Touring Cars Update 1.26
notes.content:
UI Overhaul: All elements of the UI have been updated to look better and better fit in with the game style. 

Fixed an issue with previous sector time for sector 3 not showing in time trial on track 6

notes.title: Tiny Touring Cars Version 1.25
notes.content:
Fixed bug with Race Mode where race was defaulting to time trial number of laps (99) if time trial was played before and value was not changed in Track Selection Screen.

Fixed bug on track 9 where it was not properly storing chosen number of laps. 

Updated Track Selection and Player Name screens to reflect the currently stored/selected lap numbers and names respectively.

notes.title: Update 1.24
notes.content:
Added new UI elements to reflect Time Trial mode - Removed leaderboard from Time Trial mode and added a sector time display in its place. 

Updated in Race Leaderboard to be clearer by adding blue background to leaderboard elements. 

Fixed a bug in which playing multiplayer in Race mode first would cause multiple cars to spawn in Time Trial.

notes.title: Patch 1.23
notes.content: Fixed a bug where times were not being properly recorded on first and last laps.

notes.title: Patch 1.22
notes.content: Added a warning which appears up when a player misses a checkpoint.

notes.title: Patch 1.21 - Live with Achievements
notes.content:
12 Achievements Added 
Fixed positioning of Track 5 to better fit to screen
Fixed issue with controller/arrow navigation on Track Selection Page
